purpose: Distinguish train-exact symbolic candidate generation from selecting among its accepted runtime pool on a previously-opened public-training development cohort.
decision: GENERATION_COVERAGE_LIMITATION_ON_THIS_COHORT; no evidence of a selection miss within accepted generic pool. The candidate generator expands program counts, but does not increase oracle hits.
interpretation_limits: Exploratory postscore on previously opened cohort, not an independent validation or official score.
“Not in accepted pool” identifies a generator/representation coverage problem at the runtime interface; it does not prove no larger symbolic grammar could express the answer.
Candidate exact pool max is below cap 32, so the adapter cap did not truncate the observed exact pools on these 105 grids.
next_action: Read current three-point set and repository state again, then preregister a disjoint remainder cohort before evaluating a materially different generic generator or legally sourced public model. Keep candidate changes quarantined until positive fresh-cohort gain and zero regressions.
